name: 多模态/多机制分量在代码中由同一代理量冒充
trigger: paper names distinct topology/behavior/image/text components but code computes them from the same embedding/distance without the stated modality-specific primitives
example: S044 Q3 S_topology/S_behavior both derived from one untrained embedding instead of PH/HMM
gate: each named modality/mechanism must have source data + extractor + output provenance; otherwise relabel as shared proxy and do not claim multimodal/mechanistic validation
